name: declarelang
description: Declare — a clean-slate successor to OpenLaszlo. A single self-contained distro: the compiler (.declare → JS), the browser runtime, a component library, examples, and docs. Runs a dev server with dynamic compilation, or host the whole tree statically for in-browser compilation.
author: David Temkin

scripts.test:derived: npm run build && node tools/internal/run-tests.mjs test/docs.test.mjs test/schema-completeness.test.mjs test/declare-help.test.mjs test/prewarm.test.mjs test/ops.test.mjs
scripts.test:ladder: npm run build && node test/ladder.test.mjs && node test/eval-references.test.mjs --ladder
scripts.test:mac: npm run build:mac && node test/mac-shell.test.mjs && node test/conform/conform.test.mjs --mac && node mac-host/gate.mjs
